lore: The soul force that moved an empire.
trait: Mahatma — While on the field, all Conflict scenarios are negated (do not take effect).
achievement: Satyagraha — Win a defence while none of this card's allied GP or Followers performed any action (move, retrieve, deploy, attack) in the same round.

lore: She dressed the world in modernity.
trait: Women's Fashion — All female Followers at this location gain +2 to their primary stat.
achievement: Chanel No. 5 — Have this card spend a turn with at least 1 allied Nat (GP or Follower) and 2 allied female (GP or Follower) at the same location.

lore: A revolution forged from peasant to chairman.
trait: The Long March — When being killed, this card can automatically get retrieved to its Player's hand instead.
achievement: Cultural Revolution — Have a non-allied Mus, Art, Act, or Wri GP or Follower removed from the board after a Censorship scenario ends.

lore: The last great general of Rome.
trait: Reconquest — While outnumbered at this location (more opponent cards than allied), this card gains +5 to all stats.
achievement: Reconquest — Win a combat attack while having fewer total allied cards at this location than the opponent.

lore: Deified by two civilizations for mastery of stone and medicine.
trait: Grand Architect — Once per match, permanently grant +5 to all stats of one other allied Great Person at this location. The bonus persists even if this card later moves or is archived.
achievement: Pyramid — Have at least 1 allied Arc and 1 allied Eng or Sci (GP or Follower) at this location at the same time.

lore: He turned leaves and water into philosophy.
trait: Tea Ceremony — If this card is the only Great Person at this location, all its stats gain +5.
achievement: The Classic of Tea — Have this card be the only GP at a location for 3 consecutive rounds.

lore: He built the machine that broke the unbreakable.
trait: Artificial Intelligence — Gains the highest stat of the last allied Great Person that was Archived.
achievement: Turing Test — Use this card's Artificial Intelligence trait to survive a Survival Scenario that the card could not have survived without it.

lore: A bullet for a nation's soul.
trait: Assassination — If this card was private and becomes public this turn, it may attack regardless of whether a Conflict scenario is active, targeting a player with only 1 GP at this location. This attack kills the target GP.
achievement: Korea Commemoration — Have at least one Korean location on the board occupied exclusively by Korean GP (no GP from other countries).

lore: His fortune shaped an era, for better and worse.
trait: The Syndicate — Once per round, this card earns one additional Achievement Tick whenever any other allied Great Person on the field earns one.
achievement: The Syndicate — Have at least 3 allied Ban or Mer (GP or Follower) across all locations at the same time.

lore: Grace in every frame, humanity in every cause.
trait: Humanitarian Presence — While this card is face-up on the field, once per round the player may redirect one opponent event targeting any allied card at any location to have no effect.
achievement: UNICEF — Have this card spend a turn at the same location as at least 1 allied Doc or Mon (GP or Follower) while no conflict scenario is active.

lore: She played from the heart when the world told her to stand aside.
trait: Musical Bond — If there is exactly one male Musician (Great Person or Follower) at this location, both this card and that card gain +3 to all stats.
achievement: Lieder Album — Have this card at the same location as exactly one allied male Mus GP or Follower for 2 consecutive rounds.

lore: He handed the world a ruler and said: begin.
trait: Geometric Deduction — The special effects of this card's current location also apply to all other locations on the field.
achievement: Elements — Have allied GP and Followers distributed across every location currently on the board, with an equal number at each.

lore: In a monastery garden, he found the code of life.
trait: Heredity Laws — When this card is Archived, the player may grant +10 to any one stat of the next Great Person they deploy.
achievement: Pea Garden — Have at least 2 allied Nat (GP or Follower) at this location at the same time.

lore: She rode in her father's armor and shook the walls of legend.
trait: Gender Disguise — All Great Person traits related to Gender on the field are disabled.
achievement: Join Army for Father — Win a Battlefield defence with at least one allied Sol GP or Follower at the same location.

lore: He carried Beethoven's shadow and carved his own light.
trait: Perfectionism — If the sum of a specific stat of all allied cards at this location is ≥ 25, gain +3 to that stat; otherwise −3.
achievement: Hungarian Dances — Have this card at the same location as at least 1 allied Mus and 1 allied Wri (GP or Follower) at the same time.

lore: The greatest knight of the realm, undone by the greatest love.
trait: Oath of Valor — While this card has never moved since deployment, it wins all stat ties. If it ever moves, it permanently loses this ability for the rest of the match.
achievement: The Grail Quest — Have this card at the same location as 2 or more allied Sol (GP or Follower), none of which moved this turn.

lore: Sorrow and beauty, distilled into verse.
trait: Delicate Restraint — While this card is on board, you may deploy an unlimited number of Wri, Art, Mus, or Act Followers per turn.
achievement: Sheng Sheng Man — Have every player deploy exactly 2 cards (GP or Follower total) to this location at the same time.

lore: A kingdom inherited, a revolution unleashed.
trait: Locksmith — All non-allied GP and Followers at the same location cannot move to another location or be retrieved by their player.
achievement: Guillotine — Have more than 1 GP or Follower killed at this location in the same turn while Louis XVI is present.

lore: She wore the crown of Versailles until the crowd came for it.
trait: Madame Déficit — All GP at the same location as this card get −3 Wealth.
achievement: Queen's Designer — Have an Art or Mer GP at this location get archived in the same turn.

lore: The sword and the mind — both perfected.
trait: Niten Ichi-ryu — Can attack twice per turn.
achievement: Undefeated — Win 2 attacks in the same turn using this card.

lore: He built the world's first empire from nothing but will.
trait: First Empire — When this card defeats an opponent in combat, it gains an additional Achievement Tick.
achievement: First Empire — Have allied GP or Followers deployed to at least 4 different locations at the same time.

lore: Two-thirds god, one-third man — he built the walls of Uruk and sought the secret of eternal life.
trait: Epic of Gilgamesh — After this card wins 3 rounds at this location, it gains +10 to all stats for the rest of the game.
achievement: Two-Thirds Divine — Have this card and Enkidu at the same location at the same time.

lore: Born of clay and wildness, he became the greatest friend a king ever had.
trait: Forest Wildman — A Location with Forest feature provides +2 Strength and +2 Technique to this card and all Allied GP and Followers at it.
achievement: Gilgamesh Epic — This card and another Sumer GP card move from a Mesopotamia location to another Mesopotamia location together in the same turn.

lore: Under his hand, Athens became the school of Hellas.
trait: Athenian Democracy — Gains an additional +1 to all stats for each allied Follower at this location.
achievement: Funeral Oration — Have an allied GP killed at this location by an opponent in the same turn.

lore: She taught the greatest minds of Athens — including Socrates himself.
trait: Voice Behind the Throne — This card cannot be directly attacked. Any scenario that would eliminate an allied Great Person here may instead eliminate one allied Follower of the player's choice.
achievement: School of Athens — Have this card at the same location as at least 2 allied Phi (GP or Follower) at the same time.

lore: King of Sparta, twice exiled, twice restored — a king who chose peace over glory.
trait: The Recalled King — Whenever this card would be eliminated, retrieve it to hand instead. It may then be immediately redeployed to any location for free.
achievement: Thirty Years' Peace — Have this card draw 2 different rounds (combat or event) during the same game.

lore: The greatest orator of Rome — words were his sword and shield.
trait: Consul's Veto — Once per match, cancel any single opponent action at this location — deployment, move, event, or attack. The action is void and any costs are refunded.
achievement: Philippics — Use the Consul's Veto trait and have at least 1 allied Sta (GP or Follower) at this location in the same turn.

lore: He first declared the sun is not a god, but a burning stone larger than all of Greece.
trait: Mind Over Matter — Once per match, when this card would be eliminated, discard 2 Follower cards instead to keep it on the field with +5 to all stats.
achievement: Nous — Have this card at the same location as at least 2 allied Phi or Sci (GP or Follower) at the same time.

lore: He proved motion was impossible — and the world has never stopped arguing.
trait: The Paradox — Once per match, declare the current scenario a draw: neither side wins, no Achievement Ticks are awarded, and both cards remain on the field.
achievement: Achilles and the Tortoise — Use the Paradox trait and have this card remain at the same location without moving for 3 consecutive rounds.

lore: He gave us algebra and the algorithm — the invisible foundation of every computer ever built.
trait: Algebraic Induction — This card gains all numerical stat bonuses currently received by other revealed Great Persons on the field.
achievement: Algebra — Have allied GP and Followers on board whose base stats together include every integer from 1 to 25.

lore: The Prophet of Light painted his gospels in vivid color across three continents.
trait: Two Lights — This card is immune to all Survival Scenario effects. While allied Great Persons of two or more different eras share this location, all allied cards here gain +3 to all stats.
achievement: Light and Dark — Have allied GP or Followers from at least 2 different eras at this location at the same time.

lore: His brush turned the Renaissance into fire and flesh — the last great master standing.
trait: The Portraitist — Get the trait of the Allied Great People if there is only one at the same location.
achievement: Self-Portrait — Have at least 1 allied archived GP whose trait this card has inherited.

lore: He proved the world was round by sailing its circumference — and died before he saw it complete.
trait: Long-distance Voyage — This card and all Allied GP get extra +1 on all stats in a Global Competition.
achievement: Circumnavigation — Visit all the locations on the board in public continuously (without being turned into private, being retrieved or being killed).

lore: She left the convent walls to cradle the dying in Calcutta's gutters — and sparked a worldwide movement of radical compassion.
trait: Called to Serve — Once per match, voluntarily archive this card to return up to 3 allied Followers that were eliminated from any location back to the player's hand.
achievement: Houses of the Dying — Have at least 2 allied Mon (GP or Follower) at this location at the same time.

lore: He named the world — every living thing classified by his elegant two-word system.
trait: Systema Naturae — Once per match, swap any two allied Great Persons' locations as a free action. Both relocated cards count as freshly deployed for that round.
achievement: Systema Naturae — Have at least 4 different identity types of allied Followers at this location at the same time.

lore: His music spoke what words could not — joy and madness in the same key.
trait: Fantasia — Cards at this location are immune to Survival Scenario effects in the first round this card is deployed or moved here; this card cannot terminate the Survival Scenario.
achievement: Marriage of Love — Have this card spend a turn with only 1 allied female Mus (GP or Follower) at the same location, both performing no actions.

lore: He gave Einstein the mathematics to prove relativity — and modestly called it Einstein's theory.
trait: Lorentz Transformation — All Great Person traits related to Era or Location on the field are disabled.
achievement: Lorentz Force — Have a GP on the board get force-retrieved without being attacked.

lore: She aimed for the horizon and flew straight through every barrier in her path.
trait: The Lady Lindy — This card is immune to all Survival Scenario effects; it always survives regardless of stat thresholds.
achievement: First Solo Atlantic — Have this card survive a natural hazard scenario at a location where no other allied GP or Follower is present.

lore: He invented the language of film — montage as a weapon of art and revolution.
trait: Dialectical Montage — Once per match, play two event cards simultaneously from your hand at this location. Both effects resolve in the order you choose.
achievement: Battleship Potemkin — Play 2 event cards at this location in the same turn.

lore: He stood on top of the world — and then spent decades helping the people who lived there.
trait: First Ascent — When this card wins an attack, it gains 2 Achievement Ticks instead of 1.
achievement: Summit — Have this card and Tenzing Norgay at the same location at the same time.

lore: He knew every ridge and crevice of Everest — and chose to climb it side by side.
trait: Mountain Guide — Once per turn, move one other allied Great Person to this location as a free action (does not consume that card's move).
achievement: Together — Have this card and Edmund Hillary at the same location at the same time.

lore: He modernized Japan in a generation — and paid the ultimate price for empire.
trait: Meiji Architect — Once per match, declare this location's era to be any era of your choice for one round.
achievement: Meiji Constitution — Have at least 1 allied Sta and 1 allied Eng or Sci (GP or Follower) at this location at the same time.

lore: The King of Pop — the most famous entertainer in human history.
trait: King of Pop — While at a location, all players may deploy an unlimited number of Follower cards to this same location.
achievement: Moon Walk — Have this card spend a turn with at least 1 allied Ast (GP or Follower) and 1 allied Mus (GP or Follower) at the same location.

lore: He turned the stage into a philosopher's lecture hall.
trait: Paradoxical Wit — Once per match, negate all trait-based stat bonuses of all cards at this location for one round.
achievement: Pygmalion — Have this card at the same location as at least 1 allied Act and 1 allied Wri (GP or Follower) at the same time.

lore: In a role he was born to play, he gave America its conscience.
trait: Standing for Justice — All events played by opponents at this location must be declared publicly before resolving. The player may discard one Follower to negate any such event.
achievement: To Kill a Mockingbird — Have this card at the same location as at least 1 allied Law (GP or Follower) while a Conflict scenario is active.

lore: She united a kingdom, funded a new world, and reshaped history.
trait: Royal Decree — Once per match, remove all Followers of one chosen opponent from any one location on the field. This card must then move to that location.
achievement: New World Patronage — Have at least 1 allied Exp (GP or Follower) at this location while it is your turn.

lore: Under his reign, Portugal held the key to the world's treasure chest.
trait: Maritime Empire — Whenever this card moves to a new location, the player may bring any number of allied Followers from the previous location to the new one at no cost.
achievement: Spice Routes — Have allied GP or Followers at 3 or more different locations simultaneously, each from a different era.

lore: The warrior-king who built the world's first great library.
trait: Library of Nineveh — Once per match, look at the top 3 cards of any one pile; rearrange them in any order.
achievement: Conqueror-Scholar — Have this card at the same location as an allied Sch (Scholar) GP while this location is under your control.

lore: The architect of empires — his Arthashastra mapped every lever of power.
trait: Arthashastra — Whenever an opponent deploys a card, this player may reveal a card from hand; if it shares an identity with the deployed card, that opponent's card gets −2 to all checks this round.
achievement: Kingmaker — Have this card allied with a Sovereign GP at the same location while winning a Diplomacy scenario.

lore: His feet rewrote the rules of what a human body could do.
trait: Hand of God — Once per match, this card may convert a failed Conflict attempt into a draw instead of a loss.
achievement: Goal of the Century — Have this card succeed in a Conflict scenario against an opponent with 2 or more Followers at that location.

lore: A silkworm fell into her cup — and she wove civilization's finest thread.
trait: Silk Secret — All allied Mch (Merchant) GP or Followers at this location gain +3 to wealth checks.
achievement: Sericulture — Have this card at the same location as at least 1 allied Mch (Merchant) and 1 allied Nat (Naturalist) GP or Follower simultaneously.

lore: He held the first title of physician — carved in wood at the dawn of medicine.
trait: First Physician — Once per match, when any GP at this location would be eliminated, this card may prevent that elimination.
achievement: Ancient Healing — Have this card at the same location as 2 or more allied GP cards that are not Doctors.

lore: No vestige of a beginning, no prospect of an end — he read time in stone.
trait: Deep Time — Each round this card stays at the same location without acting, it gains +1 to all stat checks (max +3).
achievement: Geological Survey — Have this card remain at the same location for 3 consecutive rounds without being moved.

lore: She sat with chimpanzees and taught the world what it means to be human.
trait: Primates Expert — A Location with Jungle feature provides +2 Technique and +2 Intelligence to this card and all Allied GP and Followers at it.
achievement: Chimpanzee Feeding Stations — At a location with Jungle feature, this GP ends a Survival.

lore: He turned clay into an empire — and pottery into prestige.
trait: Industrialist Potter — Each round this card earns wealth, all allied Mch (Merchant) GP or Followers at any location gain +2 to wealth checks.
achievement: Wedgwood Blue — Have this card at a location where the combined technique of allied GP totals 30 or more.

lore: More Michelin stars than any chef in history — perfection plated, always.
trait: Chef de la Cuisine — Allied Gou (Gourmet) GP or Followers at this location gain +3 to technique checks and +2 to wealth checks.
achievement: L'Atelier — Have this card at a location with 3 or more Followers deployed by the same player.

lore: He stopped the cycle of blood — the first king to rule by written law, not murder.
trait: Edict of Succession — Once per match, prevent the forced removal of any one allied card from the field.
achievement: Law of the Land — Win a Diplomacy scenario while this card is at the same location as an allied Sta (Statesman) GP.

lore: The great hero who renounced the world to conquer the self.
trait: Ahimsa — While this card is on the field, allied Followers cannot be used in Conflict actions but gain +3 to all non-Conflict checks.
achievement: Nirvana — Have this card at the same location as at least 2 allied Monastic or Prophet GP or Followers while winning a non-Conflict scenario.

lore: He tracked the stars and seasons — his tomb paintings still teach us how Egyptians lived.
trait: Star Chart — At the start of each round, the player may look at the top card of the event deck before deciding their action.
achievement: Astronomical Record — Have this card at the same location as 2 different Sch (Scholar) GP or Followers simultaneously.

lore: He carved the world's longest funerary text — a library etched in stone for eternity.
trait: Sacred Texts — All allied Mon (Monastic) and Prs (Priest) GP or Followers at this location gain +2 to belief checks.
achievement: High Priest — Have this card at a location with at least 2 allied Monastic or Priest cards while winning a Diplomacy scenario.

lore: Lady Overseer of Female Physicians — history's first known female doctor.
trait: Lady of Medicine — Once per match, when any female GP at this location would be eliminated, this card may prevent that elimination.
achievement: Medical Overseer — Have this card at the same location as 2 or more allied female GP or Followers.

lore: He broadcast from Baghdad while the bombs fell — the voice from inside the storm.
trait: On the Ground — Whenever a Conflict scenario resolves at this location, this player draws 1 extra card from the event deck.
achievement: War Correspondent — Have this card present at the same location as a Conflict scenario resolution 3 times in a match.

lore: He put a thousand songs in your pocket and a computer in your hand.
trait: Think Different — Once per match, this card may ignore one card effect that targets it.
achievement: One More Thing — Have this card at a location where the combined technique of allied GP exceeds that of any opponent's GP at the same location.

lore: He sang the world's first Sanskrit epic and set the hero's journey in verse.
trait: Adi Kavi — Allied Wri (Writer) GP or Followers at this location gain +3 to culture checks; the first time this card is attacked each match, negate the attack.
achievement: Epic Verse — Have this card at the same location as 2 or more allied Wri (Writer) or Phi (Philosopher) GP or Followers.

lore: She seized an empire, expanded it beyond imagination, and ruled it with an iron intellect.
trait: Enlightened Empress — While this card is on the field, allied Sov (Sovereign) and Sta (Statesman) GP gain +2 to politics checks.
achievement: Mother of Russia — Have this card as the only GP at a location while allied GP are simultaneously present at 2 other locations.

lore: She negotiated with kings and conquered kingdoms — never surrendering to empire.
trait: Queen of Ndongo — When this card defends against a Conflict, the attacking player must first discard an Event card, or the attack is cancelled.
achievement: Resilient Throne — Have this card's location survive three consecutive Rounds without losing a Conflict.

lore: From the steppes of Asia, his cavalry swept across the world's largest empire.
trait: Golden Horde — When this card attacks, it may bring 1 allied Warrior or Soldier at the same location to join the attack for free.
achievement: Conquest March — Have this card successfully attack 3 different locations in a single game.

lore: He built the greatest empire Southeast Asia had ever known — through war and wisdom alike.
trait: Toungoo Expansion — When this card moves, it may immediately deploy 1 Follower from hand at the destination for free.
achievement: Unified Realm — Have this card and 2 allied GP at the same location for 3 consecutive turns.

lore: He pressed clay into ceramic type, and from his hands the world began to read.
trait: Movable Type — Once per game, this card may copy 1 achievement from any card in the GP discard pile.
achievement: Print Run — Have this card in play while an allied Writer or Educator GP resolves an achievement in the same round.

lore: He bent stone to the rules of the infinite — curves where others saw only walls.
trait: Infinite Spiral — When this card is at a location with a Bernini card, both cards gain +3 Culture.
achievement: Roman Baroque — Have this card at an Italy location while another Architect GP is also present.

lore: He turned marble into breath, giving stone the warmth of living skin.
trait: Papal Sculptor — While at a Rome location, this card gains +4 Reputation and its achievements trigger on 1 fewer turn.
achievement: St. Peter's Colonnade — Have this card's location have the highest Culture total on the board for 2 consecutive turns.

lore: He walked 75,000 miles across three continents — every step written into the Rihla.
trait: Rihla — This card may move freely each turn without spending an action. At each new location, draw 1 Event card.
achievement: Seven Seas — Have this card visit 5 different locations over the course of a game.

lore: He pressed ink to paper and printed a revolution — one page at a time.
trait: Printing Press — When any allied Writer or Educator resolves an achievement, this card also gains 1 Winning Point.
achievement: Bible of 42 Lines — Have this card in play at a location while 2 allied Writers or Educators are also present.

lore: With 13 ships he faced 333 — and won. The turtle ship cut through the Japanese fleet like iron.
trait: Turtle Ship — When this card defends at a water or coastal location, its Strength is doubled.
achievement: Battle of Myeongnyang — Win a Conflict while outnumbered (fewer allied cards than the opponent at this location).

lore: He ruled the greatest empire of the Americas — until the world he knew ended in fire and betrayal.
trait: Sun King — While this card is in play, all Belief-based actions cost enemy players 1 extra action to perform.
achievement: Tenochtitlan — Have this card at the same location as 3 Followers for 2 consecutive turns.

lore: He mastered Western perspective from Jesuit missionaries and turned it into imperial porcelain.
trait: Jingdezhen Kilns — Wealth-based Followers at this card's location gain +3 Technique.
achievement: Shiyue — Have this card in play while 2 allied Artist or Merchant GP are at the same location.

lore: He ruled Palenque for 68 years and built temples that encoded the mathematics of time.
trait: Temple of Inscriptions — When this card is in play, all Belief-based events at its location deal only half damage (rounded down).
achievement: Palenque — Have this card deploy a Follower at the same location 3 times.

lore: He burned Quito rather than surrender it — the last fire of a free Inca world.
trait: Scorched Earth — When this card's location is about to be captured, destroy all Followers there. The enemy gains no Winning Points from that capture.
achievement: Last Stand — Win a Conflict against a Sovereign GP while this card has no Followers at its location.

lore: He died at Dan-no-Ura with poems sewn into his armor — a warrior who chose beauty as his final shield.
trait: Warrior-Poet — When this card is killed, reveal the top card of your GP deck. If it is a Writer or Artist, deploy it immediately for free.
achievement: Twilight Verse — Have this card survive a Conflict while having 0 Followers at its location.

lore: Behind three emperors, he rewrote Aztec history — shaping a civilization's soul from the shadows.
trait: Cihuacoatl — Once per game, this card may change the outcome of any non-combat event at its location to a success.
achievement: Shadow Throne — Have this card's location win 2 consecutive Conflicts without this card being the attacker.
